title: What a Virtual Service Edge does not support

checks.do: Whether the hardware Private Service Edge supports Source IP Anchoring, before recommending hardware for that reason.

no-sipa.statement: The Source IP Anchoring feature is not supported with Virtual Service Edges.

quotes: The Source IP Anchoring feature is not supported with Virtual Service Edges.

pse-sipa-support.title: Whether Source IP Anchoring is supported on the hardware Private Service Edge
pse-sipa-support.detail: Unverified legacy statement: 'Source IP Anchoring ... works with physical PSE' and, in the comparison table, 'Source IP Anchoring: Supported' for the PSE hardware cluster, so customers needing it 'must use physical PSE hardware'. The captured Source IP Anchoring pages and the Private Service Edge pages do not mention the other. Only the Virtual Service Edge exclusion is sourced.
